name: Antifreeze / corrosion inhibitor coolant
description: Antifreeze / corrosion inhibitor coolant named on a page read in the GEG gap-fill for Commissioning equipment and consumables.

specifications.basis: MTU A001072/02E, 2020-06, Table 17 and section 3.1.2: permissible 35-50% by volume (protection -20 C to -37 C); concentration above 50% impermissible, below 35% does not guarantee corrosion protection. (value: 35-50 % by volume)
